description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 79445/APP/2025/1142, dated 10-06-2025 (Erection of a single storey rear extension and conversion of roof space to habitable use to include 1no. front facing gable end window, 1no. rear facing gable end window and 4no. roof lights.) to change the flat roof to a pitched roof.
decision_conditions: The proposed plans indicate amendments which would result in an increase in the scale, volume and height of the built form and a change in the design and appearance of the development. The proposed changes cannot be considered as non-material as they represent a form of development beyond the scope of the planning approval. The potential impacts therefore need to be considered as part of a new planning application.
